batalha.como: Your body is a pentagram: tap the points and each point becomes a strike. The fight has turns: on ATTACK you draw your combo and he tries to block; on DEFENSE he comes at you and you mirror the limbs to block. Block or dodge and the turn flips. All on the beat.

regras.r1: Big points (head, hands, feet) connect to anything; elbow and knee only after the hand/foot on the same side or another small point. Tap the points one by one, or drag.
regras.r2: Up to 4 strikes; the energy is split between them. Tap the last point again to charge: Charge I (up to 2 strikes) and Charge II (1 strike) hit much harder.
regras.r3: ATTACK: draw your combo; he tries to guess and block. If he blocks nothing, you keep attacking.
regras.r4: DEFENSE: you know how many strikes are coming (sound and notice). Mirror each strike’s limb, in order, to block. A block always grazes you a little. Block one strike and the turn flips.
regras.r5: A heavy strike (head, elbow, knee) landing unblocked leaves you dizzy: only 1 strike next time.
regras.r6: The center lights up green rarely: run your finger through it on defense and you dodge the whole attack, losing no blood, and the turn flips.
regras.r7: Tap (or hold) the ⚡ orb above the head to fill the power bar. Full, the blue sequence shows up: draw it and Black Ice comes out — heavy damage, unblockable, and he freezes.
regras.r8: Rhythm counts: every point has a ring that closes on the beat. Connect the point as the ring closes and it’s on beat (gold point) — that strike hits 25% harder. And don’t repeat: the same combo a 3rd time in a row, he’s read it — he blocks and you lose the turn.
